testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements, buttons, nav items, form inputs, counter cards, and modals MUST include clear kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='hero-start-advertising-btn', data-testid='nav-how-it-works-link', data-testid='contact-submit-btn').
testing_and_accessibility.accessibility_standards: WCAG AA contrast ratios, Alpine.js keyboard focus trapping on overlays, clear aria-expanded state on accordions and menus.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not use transparent background on fixed navbars or dropdown menus.
Ensure dark background tinting (#070A10 / #0B0F17) with rich Amber (#F59E0B) actions.
Use Barlow Condensed for headings and Plus Jakarta Sans for body text.
Every dynamic stat block must handle loading and empty database states gracefully.
Attach data-testid to every interactive component.
